title: Store Luggage and Pick It Up
wrap_friend: 你剛剛用簡單英文寄放行李，確認取件時間和收據號碼。
scenario: You want to store a bag at a station and pick it up later.
learner_goal: Ask to store luggage, understand the pickup time, and confirm a simple receipt number.
register_notes: Polite everyday service-counter English. No lost property, liability, compensation, passport, or ID handling.
support_text: Ask to store your bag. Listen for the pickup time and keep the receipt number.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Hello. Do you want to store a bag?
turns.speak: Hello. Do you want to store a bag?
turns.translation: 你好。你想寄放一個包包嗎？

friend.hint: Ask to store your luggage here.

choices.surface: Yes, can I store this bag here?
choices.translation: 是的，我可以把這個包包寄放在這裡嗎？
choices.speak: Yes, can I store this bag here?

choices.surface: Yes, can I eat this bag here?
choices.translation: 是的，我可以在這裡吃這個包包嗎？
choices.speak: Yes, can I eat this bag here?
choices.feedback: Use store for keeping a bag somewhere. Eat does not fit.

choices.surface: Yes, can I change my ticket time?
choices.translation: 是的，我可以改票的時間嗎？
choices.speak: Yes, can I change my ticket time?
choices.feedback: This is ticket language. Here you need to ask about luggage storage.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Yes. Please pick it up by six o'clock.
turns.speak: Yes. Please pick it up by six o'clock.
turns.translation: 可以。請在六點以前取回。

inline_explain.title: pick it up by + time
inline_explain.explain: Use pick it up by to say the latest pickup time.

items.surface: pick it up by six o'clock
items.speak: pick it up by six o'clock

choices.surface: Okay, I will pick it up by six.
choices.translation: 好的，我會在六點以前取回。
choices.speak: Okay, I will pick it up by six.

choices.surface: Okay, I will pick it up at sixteen.
choices.translation: 好的，我會在十六點取回。
choices.speak: Okay, I will pick it up at sixteen.
choices.feedback: The staff said by six o'clock. Keep the time simple: by six.

choices.surface: Okay, I will take platform six.
choices.speak: Okay, I will take platform six.
choices.feedback: Six is the pickup time, not a platform.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Here is your receipt. The number is twenty-four.
turns.speak: Here is your receipt. The number is twenty-four.
turns.translation: 這是你的收據。號碼是二十四。

friend.hint: Repeat the receipt number so you remember it.

choices.feedback: This is a receipt number, not a room number.
Lost receipt handling is outside this practice. Just confirm the number.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Great. Bring the receipt when you come back.
turns.speak: Great. Bring the receipt when you come back.

friend.hint: Confirm what you will bring and close politely.

choices.surface: Okay, I will bring the receipt.
choices.speak: Okay, I will bring the receipt.

choices.surface: Okay, I will bring my passport.
choices.speak: Okay, I will bring my passport.
choices.feedback: Passport or ID handling is outside this practice. Bring the receipt.

choices.surface: Okay, please pay me for the bag.
choices.translation: 好的，請為這個包包付錢給我。
choices.speak: Okay, please pay me for the bag.
choices.feedback: Payment or compensation is outside this practice. Just confirm the receipt.

feedback: Distractors test store versus wrong verbs, pickup time versus platform number, receipt number, and forbidden identity/lost-property escalation.
tts_segments: Yes, can I store this bag here?
Okay, I will pick it up by six.
Okay, I will bring the receipt.
